A candle too becomes the cause of fire through carelessness, because the flame of a candle is open. If going out of the room, extinguish the candle. Protective guideline for protection from fire

Policy for protection from fire

Policies should be made for buildings for protection from fire. These policies should be strictly implemented, and in this regard no concession of any kind should be given.

Facilities should be kept in the building according to the law.
